**Math Check:** The Kolmogorov-Arnold representation theorem:

$$f(x) = \sum_{q=1}^{2n+1} \Phi_q \left( \sum_{p=1}^n \phi_{q,p}(x_p) \right)$$

**Environment Check:** Using Python from the active `.venv`.

## Interactive Data Check (Plotly)

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import plotly.graph_objects as go
import numpy as np

# Simulating BTC-like price movement
np.random.seed(42)
prices = 60000 + np.cumsum(np.random.normal(0, 500, 100))
times = np.arange(100)

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=times, 
    y=prices, 
    mode='lines', 
    name='BTC Simulated',
    line=dict(color='#f2a900')
))

fig.update_layout(
    title="Interactive Test: Simulated BTC Price",
    xaxis_title="Time Steps",
    yaxis_title="Price (USD)",
    template="plotly_dark",
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=40, b=0),
    height=450
)

fig.show()
```
